original_test_intent: Verify TEMP_NVME_1 through TEMP_NVME_16 across IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web, proving complete ordinal coverage and mapping each temperature to the intended NVMe slot/device against the approved SPEC.
original_method: Establish target identity and a sixteen-position bay/slot inventory, record populated and absent positions plus drive identifiers and workload state, collect complete command and Web views in a bounded interval, then compare normalized fields and per-device limits without clearing logs or issuing storage resets/writes.
manual_activity: A storage/platform reviewer approves the sixteen-position bay-to-device-to-sensor map, absent-slot semantics and device-specific limits, then confirms Web pagination and the per-drive results.
required_inputs: Approved NVMe temperature SPEC by device/state
safety_requirements: Do not reset, format or write NVMe devices
Map each populated slot to stable device identity
Capture full lists and every Web page
agent_execution_scope: Capture device inventory and workload context
Collect full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
Capture all sixteen protected Web rows or defined absent states
engineer_actions: Review pagination and all sixteen outcomes
Resolve stale, swapped, duplicate or missing resources

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `sensor get 'TEMP_NVME_1~16'` does not enumerate sixteen sensors, while a 100-line SDR prefix can omit members and provides neither IB nor Web evidence or drive identity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture complete five-view data and build an ordinal 1-16 matrix keyed to bay/slot and stable NVMe identity, explicitly recording absent positions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Five interfaces and all sixteen ordinals remain; generic clear, literal-range and truncated evidence are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a sixteen-row matrix with sensor ordinal, bay/slot, drive serial/EUI/NGUID, model/firmware, workload, all five timestamped values and the applicable limit.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exhaustive member accounting, stable device identity and absent-slot semantics instead of trusting filtered names.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Ordinal renumbering or an absent/replaced drive can leave plausible temperatures assigned to the wrong physical storage device.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: BMC numbering can diverge from OS enumeration; only the approved chassis/backplane inventory map may bridge them.

project_override_considerations: Define the 1-16 physical position map, stable device identifiers, absent-slot behavior, telemetry source, workload context, fields and limits. Private Script use requires pinned review; no storage mutation is permitted.
expected_evidence: Sixteen-position bay/slot inventory with stable NVMe identifiers
Drive model/firmware/workload and approved thermal SPEC
Complete decoded IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists
All protected Web rows/pages or approved absent states
No-storage/SDR/thermal mutation or log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target sixteen NVMe temperature resources across five views. Generic clear and DeepSeek's non-enumerating collection are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Inventory, slot mapping, access, absent-slot policy and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if sensor ordinals cannot be mapped to physical devices after those inputs are obtained.

review_improvement: Replaces a range-like query with exhaustive sixteen-position accounting bound to stable NVMe identities and safe read-only evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: NVMe sensor numbering is a BMC presentation label, while drives are serviceable and can move or be absent. A complete set of plausible temperatures does not prove physical coverage unless each ordinal is reconciled to a bay and stable drive identity and absent positions are handled explicitly.
